$comment: Everything one game's assets share besides colour: scale, bevel and seam floors, the volume cap, per-role wear recipes, signature motifs and the forbidden list. Builder, bake_asset, review_build and the prop judge read it. Strengths are 0..1 multipliers on the toolkit's base amounts. thickness_min is the bar under which a pipe or bar shimmers at 40 studs (measured on the generator). join_fraction is the share of a volume's box that may sit inside another volume without a declared join.
motifs: hex bolt heads: six-sided studs in body2 at the load-bearing corners
exactly one emissive indicator: a stud or ring on the face a player operates; the accent is a surface, never a stud
one dull painted body, one near-black rubber or iron part, one rust trim
forbidden: a pipe, bar or handle thinner than thickness_min
scattered studs: every stud is placed and counted
a second saturated colour next to the accent, other than the emissive indicator
a smooth taper: a length steps between stations
wear or rust on the accent or the emissive role
a glued-on thin box where a cut would do
any creature, character or NPC body: characters come from the gameplay layer, the world blueprint has no character kind
a rock or cliff modelled as one sculpted surface: nature is a stack of blocks with a lighter top face
a vice prop or a crude body gag: platform policy outranks the reference, however funny the source is
